notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.chrono_trigger_arabic): a line for each box of the message (the box waits for the button between them), {line} where a line of the box must end; the encoder breaks the other lines itself, a box holding four lines of 232 pixels. {choice} at a line's start leaves the game's cursor its place at the line's right; the game's event decides which lines are choices (the English's indented option lines), so the {choice} lines must stay on the same lines of the message's last box as the English's, which the build checks. {box auto} starts a box that does not wait for the button, as the English's timed scenes do after a pause; {pause 0F} and the other pauses pass to the game as the English has them, and {pause 00}, which closes the box, ends the message where it stands (the text after it is the next message of the chain, laid out as a message of its own). A message that starts with the speaker's name and a colon (الأم: or {Marle}: ) has its other lines and boxes indented under the name, as the English does. {Crono}, {Marle}, {Lucca}, {Robo}, {Frog}, {Ayla}, {Magus}, {member 1} to {member 3}, {Epoch} and {code 11} write a name as the player gave it, in Latin letters, and a line counts 55 pixels for it; {item} and {code 12 xx} an item's or a technique's name (80 pixels); {code 0D}, {code 0E} and {code 0F} a number. The English's {Nadia} is the word Nadia, written ناديا. A translation keeps its original's commands in order. A message holds Arabic letters, spaces, Western or Arabic-Indic digits and the signs . , : ! - … ، ؛ ؟ « » ( ) ♪ only (the quotes and the brackets are drawn mirrored, as a right-to-left run shows them). No vowel marks: the font has none.

{Marle}: {Crono}!{line}لا يمكننا أن نبقى عالة على أبي!{line}اخرج وابحث عن عمل!{pause 16}{pause 00}مواها ها ها…
لقد اكتمل!{line}لقد فعلتها!

entries.context: Message 66 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Mwa, ha, ha…{box}It's complete!{line}I've done it!
entries.text:
مواها ها ها…
لقد اكتمل!{line}لقد فعلتها!

entries.context: Message 67 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {code 0D} ounces of cat food.
entries.text: {code 0D} أوقية من طعام القطط.

entries.context: Message 68 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Hard to believe Guardia is now 1000{line}years old, and our King is the XXXIII{line}descendant to the throne!{box}But how can he rule a kingdom when{line}he can't even control his own{line}daughter?!
entries.text:
من الصعب تصديق أن غارديا بلغت الآن 1000 عام، وأن ملكنا هو الوريث الثالث والثلاثون للعرش!
ولكن كيف له أن يحكم مملكة وهو لا يقدر حتى على ضبط ابنته؟!

entries.context: Message 69 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): There used to be a cathedral in the{line}woods to the west.{box}I wonder what became of it?
entries.text:
كانت هناك كاتدرائية في الغابة إلى الغرب.
ترى ماذا حل بها؟

entries.context: Message 70 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ELAINE: If only Fritz would return.{line+}I'd ask for nothing more!
entries.text: إلين: ليت فريتز يعود.{line}لن أطلب شيئا غير ذلك!

entries.context: Message 71 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ELAINE: I guess he's forgotten me.
entries.text: إلين: أظنه قد نسيني.

entries.context: Message 72 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Sometimes a mysterious whirlpool{line}appears in the ocean near here.{line}What could cause that?
entries.text: أحيانا تظهر دوامة غامضة في المحيط بالقرب من هنا. ترى ما سببها؟

entries.context: Message 73 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): It's 10 G to Porre.{line}Hop aboard?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: ثمن الرحلة إلى بوري 10 قطع ذهبية.{line}هل تركب؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 74 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Lodging is 10 G.{line+}   Check in?{line+}   No, thanks.
entries.text: ثمن المبيت 10 قطع ذهبية.{line}{choice}سأبيت هنا.{line}{choice}لا، شكرا.

entries.context: Message 75 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Been to the fair yet?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: هل ذهبت إلى المهرجان بعد؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 76 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Well get going, then!!{line}You'll have to wait a thousand years{line}for another Millennial Fair!
entries.text: هيا انطلق إذن!!{line}ستضطر إلى انتظار ألف عام حتى مهرجان الألفية القادم!

entries.context: Message 77 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Wasn't that a trip?! I spent all my{line}Silver Points at the “Tent of Horrors!”
entries.text: ألم يكن ذلك جنونيا؟! أنفقت كل ما لدي من نقاط فضية في «خيمة الرعب»!

entries.context: Message 78 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Are you buying?{line+}   Sure.{line+}   Sorry.
entries.text: هل ستشتري لي شرابا؟{line}{choice}بالتأكيد.{line}{choice}عذرا.

entries.context: Message 79 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Remember the earthquake we just{line}had?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: هل تذكر الزلزال{line}الذي وقع للتو؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 80 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): No?{line}Airhead, huh?{line}Well, never mind.
entries.text: لا؟{line}شارد الذهن، ها؟{line}حسنا، لا يهم.

entries.context: Message 81 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): We've been having too many.{line}Something's wrong…{line}Hope the “Big One” isn't coming!
entries.text: لقد كثرت الزلازل مؤخرا.{line}هناك خطب ما…{line}أرجو ألا يكون «الزلزال الكبير» قادما!

entries.context: Message 82 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The soldiers say the Chancellor's been{line}acting funny.
entries.text: يقول الجنود إن المستشار يتصرف بغرابة مؤخرا.

entries.context: Message 83 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Thanks!{line}I'll play you a song.
entries.text: شكرا!{line}سأعزف لك أغنية.

entries.context: Message 84 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): See ya around.
entries.text: أراك لاحقا.

entries.context: Message 85 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Come on in!{line}Take your bloody time…!{line}I'd rather serve you than go to the{line}fair, anyway…
entries.text: تفضل بالدخول!{line}خذ كل وقتك…!{line}خدمتك أحب إلي من الذهاب إلى المهرجان، على أي حال…

entries.context: Message 86 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Why is there a different guard on duty{line}at the castle every time I go there?
entries.text: لماذا أجد حارسا مختلفا في الخدمة بالقلعة في كل مرة أذهب إليها؟

entries.context: Message 87 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Hi!{line}Do you know about our establishment?{line+}   No.{line+}   Yes.
entries.text: مرحبا!{line}هل تعرف شيئا عن مؤسستنا؟{line}{choice}لا.{line}{choice}نعم.

entries.context: Message 88 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): This is the Mayor's Education Center.{line}Think of it as a workshop for{line}beginners!{box}You can take the things you find here!
entries.text:
هذا هو مركز العمدة التعليمي.{line}اعتبره ورشة عمل للمبتدئين!
يمكنك أن تأخذ الأشياء التي تجدها هنا!

entries.context: Message 89 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Scattered throughout this world are{line}places where you can save your game.{line}Save whenever you can, especially in{line}unfamiliar or dangerous areas!
entries.text: تنتشر في أنحاء هذا العالم أماكن يمكنك فيها حفظ لعبتك. احفظ كلما أمكنك ذلك، وخاصة في المناطق غير المألوفة أو الخطرة!

entries.context: Message 90 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): That's just a replica. Record your{line}journey whenever you find the real{line}McCoy!{box}You'll find more of them in riskier{line}areas.{box}Also, remember that you can log in{line}anywhere on the World Map!
entries.text:
هذه مجرد نسخة مقلدة. سجل رحلتك كلما وجدت نقطة حفظ حقيقية!
ستجد المزيد منها في المناطق الأكثر خطورة.
وتذكر أيضا أنه يمكنك الحفظ في أي مكان على خريطة العالم!

entries.context: Message 91 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Need a brief Weapons and Items{line}seminar?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: أتريد درسا سريعا عن{line}الأسلحة والأدوات؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 92 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Weapons include swords, bows, and{line}guns.{box}Some weapons can only be used by{line}specific party members.{box}You'll find a variety of armor for the{line}head and body.{box}Finally, there are numerous accessories{line}with unique properties and effects.{box}As you gain Power, swords will inflict{line}greater damage. Bows and guns get{line}more powerful as your Hit rate{line}increases.
entries.text:
تشمل الأسلحة السيوف والأقواس والمسدسات.
بعض الأسلحة لا يستطيع استخدامها إلا أعضاء معينون في الفريق.
ستجد أنواعا متعددة من الدروع للرأس والجسد.
وأخيرا، هناك إكسسوارات عديدة ذات خصائص وتأثيرات فريدة.
كلما زادت قوتك، ألحقت السيوف ضررا أكبر. وتزداد الأقواس والمسدسات قوة كلما ارتفع معدل إصابتك.

entries.context: Message 93 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You can walk while reading messages.{line}But go too far, and you can miss them!
entries.text: يمكنك أن تمشي وأنت تقرأ الرسائل.{line}لكن إن ابتعدت كثيرا، فقد تفوتك!

entries.context: Message 94 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Use the Y Button to move the{line}Message/Battle window up or down.
entries.text: استخدم زر واي لتحريك نافذة الرسائل والمعركة إلى الأعلى أو الأسفل.

entries.context: Message 95 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Want my advice?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: أتريد نصيحتي؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 96 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Ask the Mayor first.
entries.text: اسأل العمدة أولا.

entries.context: Message 97 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): All right, I'll teach you about skills. Are{line}you willing to learn?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: حسنا، سأعلمك شيئا عن المهارات.{line}هل أنت مستعد للتعلم؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 98 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): That's about it.{line}Feel more confident?
entries.text: هذا كل شيء تقريبا.{line}أتشعر بثقة أكبر الآن؟

entries.context: Message 99 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You've got potential!{line}You'll learn a number of “Techniques”{line}as you progress!{box}“Techniques” are magic attacks that{line}also utilize your weapons.{line}You'll acquire them with discipline.
entries.text:
لديك إمكانات واعدة!{line}ستتعلم عددا من «التقنيات» كلما تقدمت!
«التقنيات» هي هجمات سحرية تستخدم أسلحتك أيضا.{line}وستكتسبها بالتدريب.

entries.context: Message 100 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): My, my! You're so enthusiastic!{line}Use this to help you get started!{box}{line+}            A gift of 300 G!
entries.text:
يا للعجب! ما أشد حماسك!{line}استعن بهذا في بداية طريقك!
{line}هدية قدرها 300 قطعة ذهبية!

entries.context: Message 101 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Want to learn about damage in{line}battle?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: أتريد أن تتعلم عن الضرر{line}في المعركة؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 102 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Do you know about “Shelters?”{line}They're quite useful!{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: هل تعرف «المآوي»؟{line}إنها مفيدة جدا!{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 103 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Use “Shelters” at Save Points, or on the{line}World Map, to completely restore HP{line}and MP.
entries.text: استخدم «المآوي» عند نقاط الحفظ أو على خريطة العالم لاستعادة نقاط الحياة ونقاط السحر بالكامل.

entries.context: Message 104 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Some monsters have special attacks.
entries.text: لبعض الوحوش هجمات خاصة.

entries.context: Message 105 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Poison{line+}HP slowly decreases.{line+}Your attacks are weakened.
entries.text: التسمم{line}تنخفض نقاط الحياة تدريجيا.{line}وتضعف هجماتك.

entries.context: Message 106 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Slow{line+}Increases the time between attacks.
entries.text: البطء{line}يزيد الوقت الفاصل بين الهجمات.

entries.context: Message 107 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Sleep{line+}Lowers your guard.{line+}A good hit will wake you up again!
entries.text: النوم{line}يضعف دفاعك.{line}ضربة قوية ستوقظك من جديد!

entries.context: Message 108 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Chaos{line+}Confuses you into attacking allies!{line+}A little tough on friendships!
entries.text: الفوضى{line}تربكك فتهاجم رفاقك!{line}أمر لا يخدم الصداقة كثيرا!

entries.context: Message 109 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Blind{line+}You can't see too well…{line+}It's hard to hit enemies!
entries.text: العمى{line}لا ترى جيدا…{line}يصعب عليك إصابة الأعداء!

entries.context: Message 110 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Lock{line+}Can't use any “Techniques.”
entries.text: القفل{line}لا يمكنك استخدام أي من «التقنيات».

entries.context: Message 111 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Stop{line+}Immobilizes and disables you.
entries.text: التوقف{line}يشل حركتك ويمنعك من أي فعل.

entries.context: Message 112 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): In these situations your guard is down,{line}and you'll sustain more damage.{box}Use “Heal,” or wait until the battle{line}ends to heal automatically.
entries.text:
في هذه الحالات يضعف دفاعك، وتتلقى ضررا أكبر.
استخدم «شفاء»، أو انتظر حتى تنتهي المعركة لتتعافى تلقائيا.

entries.context: Message 113 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Would you like to hear more?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: أتريد أن تسمع المزيد؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 114 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): When your HP hits 0, you'll be disabled.{line}Use “Revive” to restore yourself, but if{line}everyone goes down, you're through.{box}Be careful!
entries.text:
عندما تصل نقاط الحياة إلى 0، تسقط عاجزا عن القتال. استخدم «إحياء» لتعود إلى القتال، لكن إن سقط الجميع، فقد انتهى أمركم.
كن حذرا!

entries.context: Message 115 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Hold down the L and R Buttons to{line}escape from battle!{line}Know when to run!{line}But you need to fight to grow strong!{box}Now, about the Equip menu…{line}Numbers next to the Sword and Shield{line}icons indicate Attack and Defense{line}power.{box}The higher the number, the greater the{line}power.{box}“M. Def.” indicates your ability to block{line}magic attacks. If it's 10, then magic{line}damage will be reduced by 10%.{box}A star after any characteristic means{line}it's at maximum strength.
entries.text:
اضغط زري إل وآر باستمرار للفرار من المعركة!{line}اعرف متى تهرب!{line}لكن عليك أن تقاتل لتصبح قويا!
والآن، بشأن قائمة التجهيز…{line}الأرقام بجانب رمزي السيف والدرع تدل على قوة الهجوم والدفاع.
كلما زاد الرقم، زادت القوة.
«الدفاع السحري» يدل على قدرتك على صد الهجمات السحرية. إن كان 10، فسينخفض الضرر السحري بنسبة 10 بالمئة.
وجود نجمة بعد أي خاصية يعني أنها بلغت حدها الأقصى.

entries.context: Message 116 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Huh, hey!
entries.text: هاه، مرحبا!

entries.context: Message 117 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: D, Dad!
entries.text: فريتز: أ، أبي!

entries.context: Message 118 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Working hard?
entries.text: أتعمل بجد؟

entries.context: Message 119 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: But, of course!{line+}R, right?
entries.text: فريتز: بالطبع!{line}صـ، صحيح؟

entries.context: Message 120 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ELAINE: Y, yes.
entries.text: إلين: نـ، نعم.

entries.context: Message 121 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Well, all right…
entries.text: حسنا، لا بأس…

entries.context: Message 122 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Crono}…{line}I'm in your debt.
entries.text: {Crono}…{line}أنا مدين لك.

entries.context: Message 123 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Now {Crono}, down to{line+}business.{line+}Please, buy whatever you like!
entries.text: فريتز: والآن يا {Crono}، لننتقل إلى العمل.{line}تفضل، اشتر ما يحلو لك!

entries.context: Message 124 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Welcome, {member 1}!
entries.text: فريتز: أهلا بك يا {member 1}!

entries.context: Message 125 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Thanks!
entries.text: فريتز: شكرا!

entries.context: Message 126 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Oh!{line}Hello!{line}What can I do for you?
entries.text: أوه!{line}مرحبا!{line}بم يمكنني خدمتك؟

entries.context: Message 127 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Visit our stall in Leene Square!
entries.text: تفضل بزيارة كشكنا في ساحة لين!

entries.context: Message 128 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Elaine's down at the pier again?{line}That Fritz!{line}Where could he be?
entries.text: هل ذهبت إلين إلى رصيف الميناء مرة أخرى؟{line}آه من فريتز هذا!{line}أين يكون يا ترى؟

entries.context: Message 129 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Come on in!!
entries.text: فريتز: تفضل بالدخول!!

entries.context: Message 130 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: {Crono}!!{line+}I owe you one!{line+}You saved my skin back there.
entries.text: فريتز: {Crono}!!{line}لك عندي جميل!{line}لولاك لطارت رقبتي!

entries.context: Message 131 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Man, was I up the creek!{line+}I went off on a buying trip, and{line+}ended up getting jailed with a bunch{line+}of thieves!{box+}The officials planned to execute me{line+}without a trial!{line+}What has gotten into them?
entries.text:
فريتز: يا للورطة التي وقعت فيها!{line}خرجت في رحلة لشراء البضائع، فانتهى بي الأمر مسجونا مع حفنة من اللصوص!
كان المسؤولون ينوون إعدامي من دون محاكمة!{line}ما الذي أصابهم؟

entries.context: Message 132 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ELAINE: We're forever in your debt!{line+}Thank you, again!
entries.text: إلين: سنبقى مدينين لك إلى الأبد!{line}شكرا لك مرة أخرى!

entries.context: Message 133 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): FRITZ: Hope my Dad never hears about{line+}this.{box}{line+}          Get 10 Mid Ethers!
entries.text:
فريتز: أتمنى ألا يسمع أبي بهذا أبدا.
{line}حصلت على 10 إيثرات متوسطة!

entries.context: Message 134 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Not enough cash!
entries.text: ليس لديك ما يكفي من المال!

entries.context: Message 135 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Thank you very much.
entries.text: شكرا جزيلا لك.

entries.context: Message 136 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Millennial Fair?{line}What?{line}Are you crazy?!{line}What nonsense!
entries.text: مهرجان الألفية؟{line}ماذا؟{line}هل جننت؟!{line}يا له من هراء!

entries.context: Message 137 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): “Where am I?” Are you stupid?{line}THIS is the kingdom of Guardia!{line}We're battling {Magus}'s army.
entries.text: «أين أنا؟» هل أنت غبي؟{line}هذه هي مملكة غارديا!{line}نحن نحارب جيش {Magus}.

entries.context: Message 138 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You DID know that, right?{line+}   Of course.{line+}   No.
entries.text: كنت تعرف ذلك بالتأكيد، أليس كذلك؟{line}{choice}بالطبع.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 139 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Then shut your pie hole!
entries.text: إذن فاخرس!

entries.context: Message 140 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Lovely…{line}We NEED more ignorant strangers{line}around here…
entries.text: رائع…{line}ما أحوجنا إلى مزيد من الغرباء الجهلة في هذه الأنحاء…

entries.context: Message 141 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The {Magus}'s army destroyed Zenan{line}Bridge, so the south continent is{line}inaccessible.
entries.text: دمر جيش {Magus} جسر زينان، فأصبح الوصول إلى القارة الجنوبية مستحيلا.

entries.context: Message 142 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): What a relief!{line}They finally found Queen Leene{line}wandering up in the mountains!
entries.text: يا للارتياح!{line}عثروا أخيرا على الملكة لين هائمة في الجبال!

entries.context: Message 143 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): She must be glad to be home!
entries.text: لا بد أنها سعيدة بعودتها إلى الديار!

entries.context: Message 144 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The Queen has been through a lot!{line}She's babbling about the oddest thing.
entries.text: لقد مرت الملكة بالكثير!{line}إنها تهذي بأمر غريب للغاية.

entries.context: Message 145 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Everyone was worried!{line}The King freaked when the Queen took{line}off.{box}We all thought {Magus} had grabbed{line}her.{line}Thank goodness she's safe!
entries.text:
كان الجميع قلقين!{line}جن جنون الملك عندما اختفت الملكة.
ظننا جميعا أن {Magus} قد اختطفها.{line}الحمد لله أنها بخير!

entries.context: Message 146 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): TOMA: Are you a stranger here, too?{line+}I'm Toma, the explorer.{line+}If you're buying, I'll tell you a story.
entries.text: توما: هل أنت غريب هنا أيضا؟{line}أنا توما، المستكشف.{line}إن دفعت ثمن الشراب، فسأروي لك قصة.

entries.context: Message 147 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): How about it?{line+}   Sure.{line+}   No.
entries.text: ما رأيك؟{line}{choice}بالتأكيد.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 148 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): TOMA: Thanks!{line+}It's about the missing Queen.{box+}She disappeared while visiting that{line+}cathedral to the west, and…{box+}Beg your pardon?{line+}WHAT?!{line+}They FOUND her?{line+}Never mind…
entries.text:
توما: شكرا!{line}إنها قصة الملكة المفقودة.
لقد اختفت أثناء زيارتها لتلك الكاتدرائية في الغرب، و…
عفوا؟{line}ماذا؟!{line}عثروا عليها؟!{line}انس الأمر…

entries.context: Message 149 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): TOMA: I was sure there was something{line+}fishy about that cathedral…
entries.text: توما: كنت متأكدا أن في تلك الكاتدرائية أمرا مريبا…

entries.context: Message 150 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): TOMA: So, you think I'm a beggar, huh?!{line+}Well, scram!
entries.text: توما: إذن تظنني متسولا، ها؟!{line}اغرب عن وجهي!

entries.context: Message 151 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): TOMA: How rude…
entries.text: توما: يا لقلة الأدب…

entries.context: Message 152 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): That'll be 10 G.{line}Register?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: الأجرة 10 قطع ذهبية.{line}أتريد المبيت؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 153 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Welcome!
entries.text: أهلا وسهلا!

entries.context: Message 154 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): A Millennial Fair? Here?{line}What ARE you talking about?{line}It's the year 600, and the 21st King of{line}Guardia reigns.
entries.text: مهرجان الألفية؟ هنا؟{line}عم تتحدث بحق السماء؟{line}نحن في عام 600، ويحكم غارديا الملك الحادي والعشرون.

entries.context: Message 155 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): We've been at war for years.{line}When will it end?
entries.text: نحن في حرب منذ سنوات.{line}متى ستنتهي؟

entries.context: Message 156 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): I'm Banta, the blacksmith.{line}I'm forging a bell for the King to{line}present to his beloved Queen Leene!
entries.text: أنا بانتا الحداد.{line}أصنع جرسا ليقدمه الملك هدية إلى زوجته الحبيبة، الملكة لين!

entries.context: Message 157 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): I lost it when the Queen disappeared.{line}I just couldn't keep working on the{line}bell.{line}But now it's back to business as usual!
entries.text: فقدت صوابي حين اختفت الملكة.{line}لم أستطع مواصلة العمل على الجرس.{line}أما الآن فقد عدت إلى عملي كالمعتاد!

entries.context: Message 158 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): My husband wants a daughter who is{line}as intelligent as she is beautiful.
entries.text: يتمنى زوجي ابنة تكون ذكية بقدر ما هي جميلة.

entries.context: Message 159 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): I had almost completed the bell when{line}{Magus}'s army wounded our King.{line}I've lost the will to work.
entries.text: كنت على وشك إتمام الجرس حين جرح جيش {Magus} ملكنا.{line}لقد فقدت الرغبة في العمل.

entries.context: Message 160 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): I hope this bell will ring in a new world{line}of peace.
entries.text: آمل أن يدق هذا الجرس مبشرا بعالم جديد يعمه السلام.

entries.context: Message 161 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): No window shoppers!{line}Whaddaya want?
entries.text: ممنوع التفرج دون شراء!{line}ماذا تريد؟

entries.context: Message 162 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Thanks.{line}See ya.
entries.text: شكرا.{line}إلى اللقاء.

entries.context: Message 163 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You're going to fight {Magus}'s army?{line}Wonderful! But remember to equip{line}yourself with the weapons you buy!
entries.text: ستحارب جيش {Magus}؟{line}رائع! لكن تذكر أن تجهز نفسك بالأسلحة التي تشتريها!

entries.context: Message 164 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: How do we get home?
entries.text: {Marle}: كيف نعود إلى الديار؟

entries.context: Message 165 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Your Highness, er,{line+}Princess…we…
entries.text: {Lucca}: يا صاحبة السمو، أمم… أيتها الأميرة… نحن…

entries.context: Message 166 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Please call me {Marle}!
entries.text: {Marle}: أرجوك، ناديني {Marle}!

entries.context: Message 167 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Well then, {Marle}…{line+}Observe!
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا إذن يا {Marle}…{line}انظري جيدا!

entries.context: Message 168 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Wow!
entries.text: {Marle}: يا للروعة!

entries.context: Message 169 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Lucca}!{line+}You're amazing!
entries.text: {Marle}: {Lucca}!{line}أنت مذهلة!

entries.context: Message 170 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Ain't it the truth!
entries.text: {Lucca}: وهل في ذلك شك؟!

entries.context: Message 171 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Oh, um…I mean…
entries.text: {Lucca}: أوه، أمم… أقصد…

entries.context: Message 172 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Enough with the false{line+}modesty! You have a real gift!{line+}I would trade my royal ancestry for{line+}your genius in a heartbeat!
entries.text: {Marle}: كفاك تواضعا زائفا!{line}أنت موهوبة حقا!{line}لو استطعت لقايضت نسبي الملكي بعبقريتك دون تردد!

entries.context: Message 173 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Well, if you say so…
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا، ما دمت تقولين ذلك…

entries.context: Message 174 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Anyway, I call this thing a{line+}“Gate.”
entries.text: {Lucca}: على أي حال، أسمي هذا الشيء «بوابة».

entries.context: Message 175 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    It's a kind of portal, that takes you{line+}to the same location in a different{line+}era.
entries.text: إنها نوع من المعابر، تنقلك إلى المكان نفسه في عصر مختلف.

entries.context: Message 176 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Gates are very unstable, so I used{line+}the principal behind my Telepod{line+}device…
entries.text: البوابات غير مستقرة على الإطلاق، لذا استعنت بالمبدأ الذي بنيت عليه جهاز النقل الآني…

entries.context: Message 177 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: …to create a “Gate Key.”{line+}Now we can use them as we please.
entries.text: {Lucca}: …لأصنع «مفتاح البوابة».{line}والآن بوسعنا استخدام البوابات كما نشاء.

entries.context: Message 178 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: But why did this Gate{line+}suddenly appear?
entries.text: {Marle}: لكن لماذا ظهرت هذه البوابة فجأة؟

entries.context: Message 179 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Either the Telepod had{line+}something to do with it,{line+}or…something else made it.
entries.text: {Lucca}: إما أن لجهاز النقل الآني يدا في الأمر، أو… أن شيئا آخر قد صنعها.

entries.context: Message 180 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: This is getting pretty weird.{line+}Let's at least head back to our own{line+}time!
entries.text: {Marle}: الأمر يزداد غرابة حقا.{line}لنعد إلى زماننا على الأقل!

entries.context: Message 181 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: All right!{line+}Coming, {Crono}?
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا!{line}هل ستأتي يا {Crono}؟

entries.context: Message 182 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Is it true? I heard {Magus}'s army{line}has taken the bridge!
entries.text: أهذا صحيح؟ سمعت أن جيش {Magus} قد استولى على الجسر!

entries.context: Message 183 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): They say the King has been wounded!{line}Is this the end?
entries.text: يقولون إن الملك قد أصيب!{line}هل هذه هي النهاية؟

entries.context: Message 184 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): No, the Hero has appeared!{line}He'll save us!
entries.text: لا، لقد ظهر البطل!{line}سينقذنا!

entries.context: Message 185 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Have you heard?!{line}The legendary Hero has appeared!{box}He went to see the King.{line}Now {Magus}'s army hasn't a chance!
entries.text:
هل سمعت؟!{line}لقد ظهر البطل الأسطوري!
لقد ذهب لمقابلة الملك.{line}لم يعد لجيش {Magus} أي فرصة الآن!

entries.context: Message 186 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Wearing the “Hero Medal,” the chosen{line}one has appeared!{line}We're saved!
entries.text: لقد ظهر المختار مرتديا «ميدالية البطل»!{line}لقد نجونا!

entries.context: Message 187 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): I heard {Magus}'s army is at the{line}bridge.{line}We're in trouble now!
entries.text: سمعت أن جيش {Magus} عند الجسر.{line}نحن في ورطة الآن!

entries.context: Message 188 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: Awake'th, {Crono}!
entries.text: {Frog}: استفق يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 189 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Cider please!
entries.text: عصير تفاح من فضلك!

entries.context: Message 190 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The Hero has brought us peace, and I{line}have delivered the bell to the King.{line}What more could we ask for?{box}Hurrah for Guardia!!!{line}Let's toast our land!
entries.text:
جلب لنا البطل السلام، وأنا سلمت الجرس إلى الملك.{line}ماذا نطلب أكثر من ذلك؟
عاشت غارديا!!!{line}لنشرب نخب بلادنا!

entries.context: Message 191 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Now we'll have peace and prosperity.
entries.text: الآن سننعم بالسلام والرخاء.

entries.context: Message 192 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Yahoooo!!{line}Somebody STOP me!!!{line}Hurrah to the Hero and Guardia!
entries.text: ياهووووو!!{line}فليوقفني أحد!!!{line}عاش البطل وعاشت غارديا!

entries.context: Message 193 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): They've built a Town Square to{line}celebrate peace.
entries.text: لقد أقاموا ساحة عامة احتفالا بالسلام.

entries.context: Message 194 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): And they've named it after Queen{line}Leene.
entries.text: وقد سموها على اسم الملكة لين.

entries.context: Message 195 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): What a happy occasion!{line}Let's get crazy!
entries.text: يا لها من مناسبة سعيدة!{line}لنمرح حتى الجنون!

entries.context: Message 196 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Let's wage peace from now on!
entries.text: لنشن السلام من الآن فصاعدا!

entries.context: Message 197 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): My dream has come true.{line}Peace is ours!
entries.text: لقد تحقق حلمي.{line}السلام لنا!

{Crono}!

{Crono}…، {Crono}…!

{Ayla}: {Crono}!{line}لااااا!!!
{Crono}!

entries.text: {Marle}: آه…

entries.text: {Frog}: ماذا…؟

entries.text: {Ayla}: فوغا!

entries.text: شيء ما يتفاعل مع القلادة.{line}أتأخذ ما بداخل الصندوق؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 210 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): This box has been in the family for{line}generations.{line}Open it, and you may have what's{line}inside.
entries.text: هذا الصندوق تتوارثه عائلتنا منذ أجيال.{line}إن فتحته، فما بداخله لك.

{line}وجدت الدرع الأزرق!

entries.text: {line}وجدت الصدرية الزرقاء!

entries.context: Message 219 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOTS: …the MAN!
entries.text: الروبوتات: …الرجل!

entries.context: Message 220 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): THE MAN: Like, thanks for the intro,{line+}babe!
entries.text: الرجل: شكرا على التقديم يا جميل!

entries.context: Message 221 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): THE MAN: You lowlifes can call me{line+}Johnny.{box+}Now listen up. Part of an old highway{line+}leads through these ruins.{line+}Think you can beat me in a bike{line+}race?
entries.text:
الرجل: أيها الحثالة، يمكنكم مناداتي جوني.
والآن اسمعوا جيدا. ثمة جزء من طريق سريع قديم يمر عبر هذه الأطلال.{line}أتظنون أن بوسعكم هزيمتي في سباق دراجات؟

entries.context: Message 222 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: Use that “Jet Bike” and… don't{line+}chicken out, babe!
entries.text: جوني: استخدم تلك «الدراجة النفاثة» و… إياك أن تجبن يا صاح!

entries.context: Message 223 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: The Man rides like a roller{line+}coaster!
entries.text: الروبوت: الرجل يقود بجنون كقطار الملاهي!

entries.context: Message 224 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Winning does that to Johnny's{line+}hair.
entries.text: الروبوت: هكذا يصبح شعر جوني حين يفوز!

entries.context: Message 225 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: You're worthless!
entries.text: الروبوت: أنت لا تساوي شيئا!

entries.context: Message 226 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Give it up!{line+}Go home!
entries.text: الروبوت: استسلم!{line}عد إلى بيتك!

entries.context: Message 227 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: J…Johnny lost!
entries.text: الروبوت: ج… جوني خسر!

entries.context: Message 228 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Hey, you're not half bad!
entries.text: الروبوت: عجبا، لست سيئا على الإطلاق!

entries.context: Message 229 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: …{line+}Do you know how to ride?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: جوني: …{line}أتعرف كيف تقود الدراجة؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 230 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: Need some pointers?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: جوني: أتحتاج إلى بعض النصائح؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 231 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: All right, listen up.{line+}The gas is on auto, so there's only{line+}one speed…FAST!{box+}Use the Control Pad to steer.{line+}Press the B Button for a Turbo Boost.{box+}I'll give you 3 of them, but it takes a{line+}moment to recharge between{line+}boosts!{box+}Check your position at the bottom of{line+}the screen.{line+}Now show me what you got, babe!
entries.text:
جوني: حسنا، اسمع جيدا.{line}التسارع يعمل آليا، لذا ليس هناك سوى سرعة واحدة… القصوى!
استخدم لوحة الاتجاهات للتوجيه.{line}اضغط زر بي لتفعيل الدفع التوربيني.
سأعطيك 3 دفعات، لكنها تحتاج إلى لحظة لإعادة الشحن بين دفعة وأخرى!
راقب موقعك في أسفل الشاشة.{line}والآن أرني ما لديك يا صاح!

entries.context: Message 232 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: YOU beat me?{line+}I don't get it!{line+}You can challenge me anytime.{line+}We'll ride the wind, babe!
entries.text: جوني: أنت بالذات هزمتني؟ لا أفهم!{line}يمكنك أن تتحداني في أي وقت.{line}سنمتطي الريح يا صاح!

entries.context: Message 233 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: My grannie rides faster than{line+}that!{line+}Hop on again, if you think you can{line+}handle it, babe.
entries.text: جوني: جدتي تقود أسرع من هذا!{line}اركب مجددا إن كنت تظن أنك قادر على ذلك يا صاح.

entries.context: Message 234 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: Where's spike head?{line+}I only ride with him.
entries.text: جوني: أين صاحب الشعر الشائك؟{line}لا أتسابق إلا معه.

entries.context: Message 235 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: Ha! What losers!{line+}You CAN walk your way across but{line+}that's monster city!{box+}Ride again, if you think you can{line+}handle it, chump.
entries.text:
جوني: ها! يا لكم من فاشلين!{line}بوسعكم عبور الطريق سيرا على الأقدام طبعا، لكن المكان مرتع للوحوش!
تسابق مجددا إن كنت تظن أنك قادر على ذلك يا مغفل.

entries.context: Message 236 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): JOHNNY: Hey! Looks like you have a{line+}neat gadget there!{line+} Ask Rx-xR how to use it.
entries.text: جوني: يا صاح! يبدو أن معك جهازا رائعا!{line}اسأل ركس-إكسر كيف تستخدمه.

entries.context: Message 237 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Greetings, lifeforms!{line+}I am Rx-xR, the Log Keeper.{line+}I'll record your 3 fastest times.{box+}There are two ways to race Johnny.{line+}Which do you prefer?
entries.text:
ركس-إكسر: تحياتي أيتها الكائنات الحية!{line}أنا ركس-إكسر، حافظ السجلات.{line}سأسجل لكم أسرع 3 توقيتات.
هناك طريقتان للتسابق مع جوني.{line}أيهما تفضلون؟

entries.context: Message 238 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: That's a new High Score!!{line+}Impressive!
entries.text: ركس-إكسر: هذا رقم قياسي جديد!!{line}مبهر!

entries.context: Message 239 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): 1     {code 0E}{line}2     {code 0E}{line}3     {code 0E}
entries.text: 1 {code 0E}{line}2 {code 0E}{line}3 {code 0E}

entries.context: Message 240 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Unbelievable!{line+}You broke the 1500 point barrier!!{line+}This is for you!
entries.text: ركس-إكسر: غير معقول!{line}لقد كسرت حاجز 1500 نقطة!!{line}هذا لك!

entries.context: Message 241 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}        You got a PowerTab!
entries.text: {line}حصلت على قرص القوة!

entries.context: Message 242 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Amazing!{line+}Take this!
entries.text: ركس-إكسر: مذهل!{line}خذ هذا!

entries.context: Message 243 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}         Receive a Full Tonic!
entries.text: {line}حصلت على منشط كامل!

entries.context: Message 244 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}          Received an Ether!
entries.text: {line}حصلت على إيثر!

entries.context: Message 245 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}        Received a Mid Ether!
entries.text: {line}حصلت على إيثر متوسط!

entries.context: Message 246 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Lucky 777!{line+}You deserve a REALLY big bonus!{box}{line+}               Wow!!{line+}      You got 10 Mid Ethers!!!
entries.text:
ركس-إكسر: رقم الحظ 777!{line}تستحق مكافأة ضخمة حقا!
{line}يا للروعة!!{line}حصلت على 10 إيثرات متوسطة!!!

entries.context: Message 247 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Jumping anaconda!{line+}You broke the 2000 point mark!{line+}Take these!
entries.text: ركس-إكسر: يا للأناكوندا القافزة!{line}لقد تخطيت حاجز 2000 نقطة!{line}خذ هذه!

entries.context: Message 248 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}           Receive 5 Ethers!
entries.text: {line}حصلت على 5 إيثرات!

entries.context: Message 249 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): RX-XR: Beautiful! Over 1300 points!{line+}Let me slap some of these on ya!{box}{line+}        Receive 5 Mid Ethers.
entries.text:
ركس-إكسر: بديع! أكثر من 1300 نقطة!{line}إليك حفنة من هذه!
{line}حصلت على 5 إيثرات متوسطة.

entries.context: Message 250 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Wh, what's this?
entries.text: {Marle}: م… ما هذا؟

entries.context: Message 251 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: It's in bad shape…{line+}…but it appears to be a humanoid{line+}robot!{line+}Incredible!
entries.text: {Lucca}: حالته سيئة…{line}…لكن يبدو أنه روبوت شبيه بالبشر!{line}أمر لا يصدق!

entries.context: Message 252 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: …{line+}I think I can fix it.
entries.text: {Lucca}: …{line}أظن أن بوسعي إصلاحه.

entries.context: Message 253 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: What?!{line+}It might attack us!
entries.text: {Marle}: ماذا؟!{line}قد يهاجمنا!

entries.context: Message 254 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: I'll make sure it won't.{line+}Machines aren't capable of evil…
entries.text: {Lucca}: سأحرص على ألا يفعل.{line}الآلات لا تعرف الشر…

entries.context: Message 255 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    …humans make them that way.
entries.text: …البشر هم من يجعلونها شريرة.

entries.context: Message 256 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Lucca}, you…pity them{line+}don't you?
entries.text: {Marle}: يا {Lucca}، أنت… تشفقين عليها، أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 257 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Let me get to work now,{line+}okay?
entries.text: {Lucca}: دعيني أبدأ العمل الآن، حسنا؟

entries.context: Message 258 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Right, that does it!{box+}I'm going to give it some juice!
entries.text:
{Lucca}: حسنا، انتهيت!
والآن سأشحنه ببعض الطاقة!

entries.context: Message 259 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: ……
entries.text: الروبوت: ……

entries.context: Message 260 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Good morning!
entries.text: {Marle}: صباح الخير!

entries.context: Message 261 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Mo……{box+}Good morning, mistress.{line+}What is your command?
entries.text:
الروبوت: صبا……
صباح الخير يا سيدتي.{line}بماذا تأمرين؟

entries.context: Message 262 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: I'm not your “mistress.”{line+}I'm {Marle}!
entries.text: {Marle}: أنا لست «سيدتك».{line}أنا {Marle}!

entries.context: Message 263 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    …and this is {Crono}…
entries.text: …وهذا {Crono}…

entries.context: Message 264 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    …and {Lucca}, here, fixed you!
entries.text: …وهذه {Lucca}، هي من أصلحتك!

entries.context: Message 265 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Understood.{line+}Madam {Lucca} fixed me.
entries.text: الروبوت: مفهوم.{line}السيدة {Lucca} أصلحتني.

entries.context: Message 266 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Just {Lucca} will do.
entries.text: {Lucca}: نادني {Lucca} فحسب.

entries.context: Message 267 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Impossible.{line+}That would be rude.
entries.text: الروبوت: مستحيل.{line}فذلك سيكون تصرفا غير لائق.

entries.context: Message 268 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Look, I hate formal titles!{line+}Don't you, {Marle}?
entries.text: {Lucca}: اسمع، أنا أكره الألقاب الرسمية!{line}ألا تكرهينها أنت أيضا يا {Marle}؟

entries.context: Message 269 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Hate 'em!
entries.text: {Marle}: أكرهها!

entries.context: Message 270 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: I understand, {Lucca}.
entries.text: الروبوت: فهمت يا {Lucca}.

entries.context: Message 271 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: All right!{line+}Now what's your name?
entries.text: {Lucca}: أحسنت!{line}والآن، ما اسمك؟

entries.context: Message 272 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Name?{line+}Ah, my serial number.{line+}It is R66-Y.
entries.text: الروبوت: اسمي؟{line}آه، رقمي التسلسلي.{line}إنه آر66-واي.

entries.context: Message 273 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: R66-Y?{line+}Cool!
entries.text: {Lucca}: آر66-واي؟{line}رائع!

entries.context: Message 274 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: No!{line+}That won't do at all!
entries.text: {Marle}: لا!{line}هذا لا يصلح أبدا!

entries.context: Message 275 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Come on {Crono}, let's give{line+}him a better name!
entries.text: {Marle}: هيا يا {Crono}، لنمنحه اسما أفضل!

entries.context: Message 276 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Robo}…{line+}{Robo}…that's perfect!
entries.text: {Marle}: {Robo}…{line}{Robo}… هذا مثالي!

entries.context: Message 277 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Your new name is {Robo},{line+}okay?
entries.text: {Marle}: اسمك الجديد هو {Robo}،{line}اتفقنا؟

entries.context: Message 278 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: I am… {Robo}.{line+}Data storage complete.
entries.text: الروبوت: أنا… {Robo}.{line}اكتمل تخزين البيانات.

entries.context: Message 279 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Hey {Robo}, why aren't{line+}there any people here?
entries.text: {Lucca}: يا {Robo}، لماذا لا يوجد أحد هنا؟

entries.context: Message 280 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: ……{box+}What…{line+}What has happened here?
entries.text:
{Robo}: ……
ماذا…{line}ماذا حدث هنا؟

entries.context: Message 281 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: There WERE many humans{line+}and others of my kind in this dome.
entries.text: {Robo}: كان في هذه القبة فيما مضى{line}كثير من البشر ومن بني جنسي.

entries.context: Message 282 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: I think something awful{line+}happened here…
entries.text: {Lucca}: أظن أن شيئا فظيعا{line}قد حدث هنا…

entries.context: Message 283 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: ……{box+}It would appear so…
entries.text:
{Robo}: ……
يبدو الأمر كذلك…

entries.context: Message 284 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: But how is it that you{line+}survived?
entries.text: {Robo}: لكن كيف نجوتم أنتم؟

entries.context: Message 285 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: We came through a time{line+}warp from the year 1000.
entries.text: {Lucca}: جئنا من عام 1000{line}عبر صدع زمني.

entries.context: Message 286 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: While exploring Arris Dome{line+}we learned there was a Gate here.
entries.text: {Marle}: بينما كنا نستكشف قبة آريس،{line}علمنا بوجود بوابة هنا.

entries.context: Message 287 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: We found you when we{line+}came looking for the Gate!
entries.text: {Lucca}: وجدناك حين جئنا{line}نبحث عن البوابة!

entries.context: Message 288 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: But the door to the inner{line+}chambers is locked, so we're out of{line+}luck…
entries.text: {Marle}: لكن باب الغرف الداخلية مقفل،{line}فلا حيلة لنا…

entries.context: Message 289 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: The power is off.
entries.text: {Robo}: الطاقة مقطوعة.

entries.context: Message 290 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: If we go to the factory up{line+}north, I can pass through security{line+}and activate this dome's generator.
entries.text: {Robo}: إن ذهبنا إلى المصنع في الشمال، فبوسعي تجاوز نظام الأمن وتشغيل مولد هذه القبة.

entries.context: Message 291 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: You'd do that for us?
entries.text: {Marle}: أتفعل ذلك من أجلنا؟

entries.context: Message 292 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: You repaired me.{line+}Now it's my turn to help you.{box+}But the generator won't run for long,{line+}so someone must stay behind to{line+}open the door while the power's on.
entries.text:
{Robo}: لقد أصلحتموني.{line}والآن جاء دوري لأساعدكم.
لكن المولد لن يعمل طويلا، لذا يجب أن يبقى أحدكم هنا ليفتح الباب ما دامت الطاقة موصولة.

entries.context: Message 293 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Then {Marle} or I will stay.
entries.text: {Lucca}: إذن ستبقى {Marle} أو أبقى أنا.

entries.context: Message 294 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Who will stay behind?{line+}   {Marle}{line+}   {Lucca}
entries.text: من سيبقى هنا؟{line}{choice}{Marle}{line}{choice}{Lucca}

entries.context: Message 295 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Okay.{line+}Please be careful, {Crono}!
entries.text: {Marle}: حسنا.{line}أرجوك، انتبه لنفسك يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 296 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Right!{line+}I'll handle things here!
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا!{line}سأتولى الأمور هنا!

entries.context: Message 297 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Hi! I was getting SO bored.{line+}May I take {Lucca}'s place?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: {Marle}: مرحبا! كدت أموت من الملل.{line}أيمكنني أن آخذ مكان {Lucca}؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 298 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Looks like you need my{line+}genius after all!{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: {Lucca}: يبدو أنك تحتاج إلى عبقريتي في النهاية!{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 299 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Okay, I'll wait here.
entries.text: {Marle}: حسنا، سأنتظر هنا.

entries.context: Message 300 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Oh, all right…
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا، لا بأس…

entries.context: Message 301 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: The door won't budge.
entries.text: {Marle}: الباب لا يتزحزح.

entries.context: Message 302 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: C…can you r…repair…me?
entries.text: {Robo}: أ…أيمكنك إ…إصلاحي…؟

entries.context: Message 303 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Shh, don't talk.
entries.text: {Lucca}: صه، لا تتكلم.

entries.context: Message 304 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: You…are trying to save our{line+}world?
entries.text: {Robo}: أنتم… تحاولون إنقاذ عالمنا؟

entries.context: Message 305 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: I don't know how far we'll{line+}get, but that's the plan.
entries.text: {Lucca}: لا أعرف إلى أي مدى سنصل، لكن هذه هي الخطة.

entries.context: Message 306 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Anyway {Robo}, what are you{line+}going to do when you're repaired?
entries.text: على أي حال يا {Robo}، ماذا ستفعل حين أنتهي من إصلاحك؟

entries.context: Message 307 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: What am I…going to do?
entries.text: {Robo}: ماذا… سأفعل؟

entries.context: Message 308 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Yeah. I mean, what plans do{line+}you have for the future?
entries.text: {Lucca}: نعم. أعني، ما خططك للمستقبل؟

entries.context: Message 309 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: {Lucca}, no one has ever{line+}asked me that before!
entries.text: {Robo}: يا {Lucca}، لم يسألني أحد هذا السؤال من قبل!

entries.context: Message 310 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Good morning.
entries.text: {Robo}: صباح الخير.

entries.context: Message 311 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Robo}!{line+}You're all right!!
entries.text: {Marle}: {Robo}!{line}أنت بخير!!

entries.context: Message 312 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Lucca}, you're incredible!
entries.text: {Marle}: يا {Lucca}، أنت مذهلة!

entries.context: Message 313 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: I hope I never have to do{line+}that again…

entries.context: Message 372 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Who enters here unbidden?{line}Oh…{box}Welcome home R-66Y.{line}Or should I say, Prometheus?!{line}You dare to defile this place with{line}humans?{box}I haven't seen them in ages.{line}Let me…welcome them.{line}Come closer…
entries.text:
من ذا الذي يدخل هنا دون إذن؟{line}أوه…
مرحبا بعودتك إلى الديار يا آر66-واي.{line}أم الأحرى أن أناديك بروميثيوس؟!{line}أتجرؤ على تدنيس هذا المكان بإحضار البشر إليه؟
لم أر بشرا منذ دهور.{line}دعني… أرحب بهم.{line}اقتربوا…

entries.context: Message 375 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): 300 yrs. ago the Lavos disaster greatly{line}changed the planet.{line}At this rate, humans will die out from{line}pure despair.
entries.text: قبل 300 عام، بدلت كارثة لافوس وجه الكوكب.{line}وعلى هذا المنوال، سينقرض البشر من فرط اليأس.

entries.context: Message 376 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Don't you understand?{line}This planet would be peaceful if there{line}were no humans around.{box}And yet you still want to fight?{line}Why?
entries.text:
ألا تفهمون؟{line}كان هذا الكوكب لينعم بالسلام لو لم يكن فيه بشر.
ومع ذلك ما زلتم تريدون القتال؟{line}لماذا؟

entries.context: Message 377 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Listen well, humans.{box}Lavos's children will one day have to{line}leave to seek new planets, and prey.{box}This world COULD sustain them…if{line}humans were not around…{box}We robots will create a new order…{line}A nation of steel, and pure logic.{line}A true paradise!{box}Our “Species” will replace you…{box}So stop your foolish struggle, and{line}succumb to the sleep of eternity…
entries.text:
أصغوا جيدا أيها البشر.
سيتحتم على صغار لافوس يوما ما أن يرحلوا بحثا عن كواكب جديدة، وعن فرائس.
كان بوسع هذا العالم أن يغذيهم… لو خلا من البشر…
نحن الروبوتات سنقيم نظاما جديدا…{line}أمة من الفولاذ والمنطق الخالص.{line}جنة حقيقية!
سيحل «نوعنا» محلكم…
فكفوا عن مقاومتكم الحمقاء، واستسلموا لسبات الأبدية…

entries.context: Message 378 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You did well to come this far.{line}I am the Mother Brain of the R-Y{line}series factory.{box}Come Prometheus, you must once{line}again join us.{box}I'll reset your circuitry and erase your{line}memories.{box}Then we'll dispose of these filthy{line}humans.
entries.text:
لقد أحسنتم صنعا بوصولكم إلى هنا.{line}أنا الدماغ الأم لمصنع سلسلة آر-واي.
تعال يا بروميثيوس، عليك أن تنضم إلينا من جديد.
سأعيد ضبط دوائرك وأمحو ذكرياتك.
ثم نتخلص من هؤلاء البشر الأقذار.

لا ذكرياتي الثمينة، ولا أصدقائي الذين لا يعوضون.
